item.title: Yukiusagi
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Princess Soft, LiLiM
  • 発売日: 2001-06-15
  • スコア: なし (4 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ゆきうさぎ
  • 英語名: Yukiusagi

あらすじ

This game is staged in the town of Chelkiki, nestled in the northern part of Japan glistening like the color of silver. Its picturesque serenity has never existed on a map.Hayato Sanada, the owner of an magnificent villa, is enjoying a ride with his butler in his “Hawaiian Crusher ‡U.” It is a continuous summer-like 86 degrees inside the Hawaiian. Suddenly, a girl comes rolling down from the top of the summit in a snowball. She collides with the Hawaiian, and his beautiful car is demolished. What a way to meet a girl! The girl Yuuna helps Hayato return to his villa; he realizes that it was their destiny to meet.This slapstick comedy-adventure is staged in the land of snow, where you’ll also enjoy appearances from heroines from our other pieces of work. Amongst the laughter, this game will really make you yearn for your youthful days.
